scope: All 33 MotM species against current D:/DND source, integrated with 2024 builder; not a PHB2024 species audit.

bugs.title: Necrotic Shroud changes non-allies into enemies
bugs.repro: Select motm:aasimar level 3 / necrotic-shroud; read trait; neutral non-ally within 10 ft is excluded by musuh wording.
bugs.expected: Applies to seeing creatures other than allies, not only enemies.

bugs.title: Spring Fey Step incorrectly requires ally
bugs.repro: Select motm:eladrin level 3 / spring; willing neutral creature within 5 ft.
bugs.expected: Any willing creature, not necessarily an ally; visible unoccupied destination within 30 ft chosen by user.
bugs.actual: sentuh sekutu rela; destination restrictions not repeated

bugs.title: Teleport summaries omit unoccupied destination constraint
bugs.repro: Read Fey Step / Blessing of the Raven Queen; occupied visible square is not prohibited by local text.
bugs.expected: Destination is unoccupied and visible within 30 ft.

bugs.title: Shared Darkvision summary omits dim-light-as-bright-light benefit
bugs.repro: Open trait details for any MotM species with Darkvision.
bugs.expected: Dim light counts as bright and darkness as dim within range.
bugs.actual: Only darkness-to-dim and lack of color stated; no senses automation.

bugs.title: Species card shows possible sizes instead of selected size
bugs.repro: Set motm.size=[Small], call speciesGuide or open SpeciesCard.
bugs.expected: Selected Small is clear in stats (may separately list options).
bugs.actual: guide.size remains Medium / Small; tested directly at all levels.

bugs.title: Trance summary omits no-need-to-sleep clause
bugs.repro: Open motm:eladrin trait; compare Sea Elf/Shadar-kai.
bugs.expected: No need for sleep, separate from magic sleep immunity.
bugs.actual: Only sleep immunity and 4-hour conscious trance stated.
